prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble. Shot through a heat camera: every surface is coloured by its temperature, the hottest things blazing white and yellow, warm bodies orange and red, cold walls fading through magenta to deep blue, the coldest corners icy violet-black. Every shape and detail is still a real photograph. One frame split down the middle by a brick wall. Left: gangsters in shirtsleeves sweat beside a roaring furnace, blazing white and orange. Right: an old woman with a deeply lined face and a mole on her cheek, a grey wool shawl over her head in a frozen attic, frost on her eyelashes, her candle down to a flat puddle of wax with a tiny drowning flame, the whole room deep blue and violet-black. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
